news.title: Trump confident of India trade deal despite new tariff threat
news.text: Trump said the US and India are likely to reach a trade deal soon despite ongoing tariff-related challenges. Both countries continue negotiations, while India remains committed to increasing imports of US goods as part of the agreement. The talks aim to strengthen bilateral trade and improve market access for both nations. However, proposed new US tariffs on certain Indian exports could pose challenges before a final agreement is reached.

news.title: Switzerland's Giant Underground Battery Project
news.text: Switzerland is developing one of the world's largest underground energy storage systems using vanadium redox flow battery technology. The project is expected to store 2.1 GWh of energy and deliver 1.2 GW of power, enough to supply around 210,000 homes for a day. The initiative could play a significant role in improving renewable energy storage and supporting grid stability in the future.

news.title: Putin Offers Su-57 Fighter To Delhi As India Searches Its 5th-Gen Jet
news.text: Russian President Vladimir Putin has renewed Russia's offer to jointly manufacture the fifth-generation Su-57 stealth fighter jet with India and provide critical defence technologies. While Russia is promoting the project under India's Make in India initiative, India remains cautious due to past concerns over technology transfer, costs, stealth capabilities, and strategic considerations. As India works on its indigenous AMCA fighter program, it continues to evaluate options while strengthening defence partnerships with multiple countries.

news.title: Foreign nationals among at least 21 killed in Delhi fire
news.text: At least 21 people were killed and dozens injured after a fire broke out in a multi-storey guest house in Delhi's Malviya Nagar area. Many of the victims were foreign nationals who had come to India for medical treatment or to accompany patients. More than 40 people were rescued, and authorities have launched an investigation into the cause of the fire and whether the building had the required operating permissions. Prime Minister Narendra Modi expressed condolences and announced compensation for the victims and their families.

news.title: AirTrunk to Invest ₹3 Lakh Crore in India's Digital Infrastructure
news.text: Prime Minister Narendra Modi welcomed AirTrunk's proposed ₹3 lakh crore ($30 billion) investment in India by 2030 to develop 5 GW of data centre capacity. Backed by Blackstone, the investment is expected to significantly boost India's digital infrastructure, cloud computing, and AI capabilities, further strengthening the country's position as a global digital and technology hub.

news.title: K Annamalai Resigns from BJP, Likely to Launch New Political Party
news.text: Former Tamil Nadu BJP president K. Annamalai resigned from the BJP on Friday, and his resignation was accepted by BJP national president Nitin Nabin. Sources suggest that Annamalai, who was reportedly unhappy after being removed from the state leadership role, is planning to launch a new political party. Despite stepping away from the BJP, he has reaffirmed his strong support for Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Union Home Minister Amit Shah.

news.title: Anthropic confidentially files for IPO
news.text: AI company Anthropic, the creator of the Claude chatbot, has confidentially filed for an initial public offering (IPO). The move gives the company the flexibility to go public after regulatory review by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). Anthropic stated that the timing of the IPO will depend on market conditions and other factors, as AI firms continue seeking significant funding to support rapid growth and infrastructure expansion.

news.title: Meta Launches AI-Powered Business Agent for Customer Support and Sales
news.text: Meta has introduced its AI-powered Business Agent, a virtual assistant designed to help companies automate customer support, sales, marketing, and lead generation across WhatsApp, Messenger, and Instagram. Announced at the Conversations 2026 event in London, the tool can answer customer queries, recommend products, book appointments, and seamlessly transfer conversations to human agents when needed. Meta also unveiled a Business Agent Platform that enables businesses to build and deploy customized AI agents at scale, with integrations for tools such as Shopify, Zendesk, and Shopee.

news.title: RBI Keeps Repo Rate Unchanged, Raises Inflation Forecast and Cuts Growth Outlook
news.text: The Reserve Bank of India has kept the repo rate unchanged at 5.25% for the second consecutive policy meeting, citing inflationary pressures from rising crude oil prices amid ongoing Middle East tensions. The RBI raised its FY27 inflation forecast to 5.1% from 4.6% and lowered India's GDP growth projection to 6.6% from 6.9%, warning that higher energy costs and supply disruptions could impact economic activity in the coming months.

didYouKnow.title: The Eighth Wonder
didYouKnow.content: The concept of compound interest is often called the Eighth Wonder of the World because even small investments can grow significantly over time through the power of earning interest on both the original amount and accumulated interest.

didYouKnow.title: Startups
didYouKnow.content: Nearly 90% of startups fail, with the most common reason being a lack of market demand rather than lack of funding.

didYouKnow.title: Employee Productivity
didYouKnow.content: Businesses that invest in employee training and development often experience higher productivity, innovation, and employee retention.

didYouKnow.title: The 80/20 Rule
didYouKnow.content: Many businesses find that roughly 80% of their revenue comes from 20% of their customers, a principle known as the Pareto Principle.

didYouKnow.title: Cost vs Revenue
didYouKnow.content: For many businesses, reducing operating costs by 1% can have the same profit impact as increasing sales by several percentage points.
